function.name: code_run
function.description: Sandboxed code executor. Supports python/bash; prefer Python. Writes are limited to configured normal write roots. Do not use code_run to modify memory and do not interpret its read-only error as proof that all memory is immutable: after explicit user approval, use file_patch for eligible existing top-level memory text or file_write to create a new top-level memory .md. Protected memory code, JSON, backups, nested paths, L4, deletion, and moves still require administrator handling. For multi-step tasks, prefer one complete script. Reply code block is executed if no script arg.

script.description: [Mutually exclusive] NEVER use this param when use reply code block.

type.description: Code type: python, bash, or powershell

inline_eval.description: DO NOT USE except explicitly specified.

mode.description: sandbox (default): bubblewrap-isolated execution; host: run directly on the server for admin tasks (bash only, audited in temp/admin_ops.log)

function.name: file_read
function.description: Read file. Read before modify for latest context and line numbers

keyword.description: [Optional] If provided, returns first match (case-insensitive) with context

function.name: file_patch
function.description: Replace unique old_content with new_content. Exact match required. With GENERICAGENT_MEMORY_ROOT, interactive calls require explicit approval; the hidden memory-only completion broker may patch verified facts without asking again. Only existing top-level memory .md plus L1/L2 text are eligible; secrets, scripts, nested paths, and L4 stay denied.

old_content.description: Original text block to replace (must be unique)

new_content.description: New content. Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}} to ref file lines, auto-expanded

function.name: file_write
function.description: Create/overwrite/append files inside normal write roots. Under GENERICAGENT_MEMORY_ROOT it may only create a new top-level .md in overwrite mode; it can never replace or append existing memory.

function.name: web_scan
function.description: Get simplified HTML and tab list. Removes hidden/floating/covered elements. Call after switching pages

tabs_only.description: Show tab list only, no HTML

function.name: web_execute_js
function.description: Execute JS. Multi-call OK with different switch_tab_id. No guessing. Act accurately to reduce web_scan calls. Execute JS in ```javascript blocks if no script arg, prefer to avoid escaping

script.description: [Mutually exclusive] JS code or script path. NEVER use this param when use reply code block

no_monitor.description: Skip page change monitoring, saves 2-3s. Only for reads, not for page actions

switch_tab_id.description: [Optional] Tab ID to switch to before executing

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web via multiple backends (DuckDuckGo/Bing with auto-fallback). Returns titles, URLs, and snippets. Use for: fact-checking, current events, documentation lookup, error research. Never search for URLs you already know.

query.description: Search query string. Be specific — include version numbers, dates, or error codes when relevant.

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Fetch a URL and extract readable text content. Strips HTML tags, scripts, and styles. Supports save_to_file to persist results. Use when web_search returns a promising URL and you need the full page content.

url.description: Full URL to fetch (must include https://)

save_to_file.description: [Optional] If set, saves full content to this file path for later reading

function.name: update_working_checkpoint
function.description:
Short-term working notepad, auto-injected each turn to prevent info loss in long tasks. Call during early/mid stages, not at end. When: (1) after reading SOP, store user needs & key constraints (skip for simple 1-2 step tasks); (2) before subtask switch or context flush; (3) after repeated failures, re-read SOP and must store new findings; (4) on new task, update content, clear old progress but keep valid constraints.

Don't call: simple tasks (1-2 steps), task completed (use long-term memory tool)

key_info.description: Replaces current notepad (<200 tokens). Incremental update: review existing, keep valid, add/remove/modify. Store: pitfalls, user requirements, key params/findings, file paths, progress, next steps. Don't store: ephemeral info, obvious context, old task info when user switched tasks. Prefer over-updating over losing key info

related_sop.description: Related SOP names, tips for further re-read

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Interrupt task to ask user when needing decisions, extra info, or facing unresolvable blockers

candidates.description: Optional quick-select choices for the user

function.name: start_long_term_update
function.description: Start distilling long-term memory. Call when discovering info worth remembering (env facts/user prefs/lessons learned). Skip if memory already updated or in autonomous flow. Must call when a task that took 15+ turns is completed

function.name: jmcomic_download
function.description: 从禁漫天堂(JMComic)下载漫画本子。传入漫画的车号(album_id)即可下载全部章节图片。下载完成后返回[FILE:path]引用供后续使用。图片会被下载到temp/jmcomic/目录。

album_id.description: 禁漫天堂漫画的车号/album_id，例如 123456

function.name: doc_edit
function.description: 读写编辑 Office 文档。支持 .docx（含标题/段落/表格/格式）和 .xlsx（电子表格）。用于写报告、做表格、改合同等文书工作。

action.description: 操作类型: read=读取文档, create=创建文档, edit=编辑现有文档

path.description: 文件路径（create时是输出路径）

function.name: spawn_subagent
function.description: 创建子代理执行并行任务。子代理拥有独立 LLM 上下文和完整工具集，完成后结果可通过 collect_subagent 获取。子代理间可通过文件共享数据（写入 temp/ 互相读取）。适合搜索/代码/文档等耗时任务。

task.description: 子代理的任务描述（作为 user prompt 输入）

function.name: list_subagents
function.description: 列出所有子代理及其状态。返回每个子代理的 ID、存活状态、进度、轮次等信息。

function.name: talk_subagent
function.description: 向运行中的子代理发送消息。用于指导子代理、追加需求或纠正方向。

function.name: collect_subagent
function.description: 收集已结束的子代理结果。仅对已完成的子代理有效。

function.name: mcp_call
function.description: 调用外部 MCP 服务器的工具。默认拒绝；仅允许 GENERICAGENT_MCP_ALLOWLIST 中的 server/tool 或 server/*。需要服务器已配置在 mcp_cli 中。

server.description: MCP 服务器名称（如 github、postgres、docker）

function.name: skill_propose
function.description: Stage a Markdown Skill proposal for explicit approval. This never activates or modifies a Skill directly.

reason.description: Why this reusable workflow should become a Skill

function.name: source_change_propose
function.description: Stage an exact source, configuration, dependency-tree, or repository text replacement for explicit QQ approval. This never writes the target. The server classifies risk and binds approval to the exact path, before/after hashes, approver identity, and expiry.

function.name: session_search
function.description: Search durable conversation history. Results are always scoped to the current platform/account/conversation and never expose another conversation.

query.description: Chinese or English phrase to find (minimum 3 characters)
